nom: Estée Lauder Advanced Night Repair Multi-Recovery Complex Serum with Hyaluronic Acid & Peptides

segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers report the serum feels hydrating and non-greasy, with one saying dry patches disappeared even in harsh winter conditions.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers, including some acne-prone, mostly report no irritation or breakouts, though one reviewer with sensitive skin says it broke her out.
segments.mature: Mature-skin reviewers (40s to 70s) report firmer, less crepey, more plump-looking skin with continued use, crediting it for a more youthful appearance.
segments.combination: One reviewer used it as a mixing base with foundation, implying a light, non-greasy finish suited to combination skin.

concerns.aging: Most reviewers using it for aging concerns report smoother fine lines, firmer skin, and a more youthful look over weeks to years of use, including several in their 40s-70s; one reviewer says it did nothing for fine lines.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers consistently report improved hydration, plumpness, and reduced dryness, often noticeable the morning after use, with effects lasting through cleansing for some.
concerns.redness: Not enough reviewer detail to characterize outcomes for redness.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers with sensitive or reactive skin report the serum did not irritate or compromise their skin, describing it as gentle even for eye area use.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports dark spots faded with use; another reports no visible improvement in discoloration or dark circles.
concerns.blemishes: Two reviewers report cleared comedones and no new breakouts on acne-prone or sensitive skin, but one reviewer with sensitive, acne-prone skin reports it caused breakouts.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer describes the formula as oil-free and lightweight with no greasy residue, relevant to oil-conscious users.

aspects.libelle: Long-lasting, little goes a long way
Bottle cap does not seal well

extraits.texte: I will never understand the love for this product. It is extremely sticky and will break you out. It does nothing as far as small lines. Just bring back Idealist. It was the most perfect product ever and I used it for 25+ years. Insane to discontinue a product after 2 decades.

love love. this did not break out my super sensitive, acne prone skin at all, which already puts it ahead of most serums for me. my skin felt insanely soft and i always woke up looking glowy and healthy the next morning. i know people in their 20s usually skip products like this, but honestly that mindset is dumb. good skin is good skin, regardless of age. i recommend this to so many people. the only reason i didn't give it 5 stars is the price. it's high. that said, a little goes a long way, so the bottle lasts longer than you'd expect.

Estee Lauder advanced night repair cream is a great addition to the night routine. What I will say about the cream is that it is noticeably moisturizing. The skin around my eye feels soft and supple, and I'm sure for much older people this will be helpful as their skin becomes crepe-like. Even though I have very sensitive skin I suffered no reaction. Unfortunately, I do not see a visible difference with dark circles under my eyes. This product helped me with the skin texture, but not discoloration signs of fatigue. I would recommend the product for improved elasticity.I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes."

I have very sensitive acne prone skin. I've been on accutane twice and got off it two years ago. Since I've been doing everything to help keep my skin clear. When I say this is my holy grail!! I mean it. It hydrates my dry skin extremely well especially in the NYC winter! It also helped with my skin texture. Would 100% recommend to anyone looking to add a serum with multiple benefits to your skincare routine

I turned 30 and have had to adjust my skincare products. I couldn't seem to find a product that made a difference until a friend told me to try this serum. This is magic in a bottle. The comedones in my forehead have cleared up, my skin feels less dry but more tighter / less droopy. It is expensive but this is worth the price. Amazing for skin that isn't in its 20s anymore.

I love this product. As a 46 year old with dry sensitive skin this felt so good going on. My skin felt instantly hydrated and glowy. I use it at night before my moisturizer. It is expensive so I try to buy when there is a deal or a sale going on.

Got to love Estee Lauder. If it has your name of it, I'm sold. Everything I have ever gotten from your brand has been nothing but exquisite. But this nightly serum is nothing but. It smells so good, a very light sweet smell that everyone can agree on. It's not greasy in anyway. IT'S SILKY...LIKE VELVET SILKY. I LOVE IT! I any excess on my neck and chest. All over smells wonderful and feels soft and silky. If you wear anything over it, it goes on smooth like silk also. And I am certain it helps the staying put power of it too. My skin is noticeability of firmer, hydration is undeniable. And it's winter and on the single digits here. I always have dry skin on my face. Not this year! Good start to 2026."I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes."
